notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone! Thanks so much for being fans of the game and following us on the journey. We've been working hard on the game since September and wanted to update the demo to reflect some of the progress we've made so far. 

The biggest changes you'll notice in the demo:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Options Menu: [/b]better UI and added options to toggle on/off vibrations, and change FPS limit.
[*] [b]Better Tutorials:[/b] Improved tutorials for different mechanics of the game.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes: [/b]We stopped a few hard crashes and fixed a few UI glitches.
[*] [b]Gameplay Tuning:[/b] Pacing has been increased a bit, and the clam bomb radius has been slightly decreased.
[*] [b]Time Attack Mode Improved[/b]: Our goal is to make Time Attack mode the ultimate "hardcore" challenge mode of the game, and I think the new tuning of the mode hopefully reflects that. Newly added is that each new wave spawns a "time bubble" that must be touched to add on extra time, instead of just instantly adding new time to the player. 
[/list]

We are hoping to finish the full game sometime in the spring now as we are now focusing on adding more levels and enemies to the game. Follow our twitter @pinkhousegames or bluesky @pinkhousegamer for more updates on progress!

notes.title: Kelp Keeper Demo Available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been hard at work since SFGE polishing up the build for public release and are finally ready to release the demo to the public. We can't wait to see how far you guys can push this game to the limits :)

Please play the game and share it with all your friends, and let us know what you think! 

What is your high score? What sea creatures would you add to the game? What would you like to see added to the game? Let us know on the forums!
